sloka: रामेण हि महत् कर्म कृतम् त्वाम् अभिनिघ्नता ।आनृण्यम् तु गतम् तस्य सुग्रीवस्य प्रतिश्रवे ॥४-२०-२०॥
transliteration: rāmeṇa hi mahat karma kṛtam tvām abhinighnatā ।ānṛṇyam tu gatam tasya sugrīvasya pratiśrave ॥4-20-20॥

translations.english: '(Now turning to Sugriva she said) O Sugriva your enemy brother has been killed and your desire has been fulfilled.You will get back Ruma and enjoy the kingdom without any obstacles.'
